verdict.rationale: New Relic documents in-product AI features that produce insights and suggestions from user data. AI insights summarize workload health, performance trends and potential issues; the New Relic AI assistant answers plain-language questions to troubleshoot and explore telemetry; and the Security RX Agent analyzes CVEs and drafts remediation recommendations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and deeper documentation of how proactive suggestions are surfaced beyond these short doc snippets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI insights provide AI-powered summaries of your workload's health, performance trends, and potential issues.
It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
Skip searching the video. Have AI identify friction points for you.
The Security RX Agent assesses a vulnerability in the context of your tech stack and turns it into a suggested remediation plan.
